decks.notes: This deck focuses on utilizing the combo potential of Underworld Breach to continuously recur cards from the graveyard, generating a powerful engine for card advantage and board control. The goal is to set up the combo pieces such as Vizier of Tumbling Sands and Lotus Field to generate mana to fuel the engine. Consign to Memory and Wish provide flexibility and extra options for the combo. The deck also includes various cantrips and card filtering tools to ensure consistency and smooth gameplay. Overall, the deck is designed to efficiently execute its combo strategy while disrupting the opponent's game plan.

This deck focuses on a fast and aggressive strategy, utilizing creatures with abilities that can deal direct damage to the opponent or manipulate the battlefield. The main goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of efficient creature cards and removal spells while also providing some disruption with cards like Thoughtseize. The inclusion of Jegantha as a companion adds an extra layer of consistency and versatility to the deck. Overall, the key concept is to apply constant pressure and maintain board control to secure a quick victory.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly cycle through your library using cards like Street Wraith and Curator of Mysteries to fill your graveyard with creatures. Then, use Living End to return all of your creatures from the graveyard to the battlefield, while your opponent loses their creatures. This combo strategy allows you to overwhelm your opponent with powerful creatures and disrupt their game plan. Additionally, you have access to Counterspells like Force of Negation to protect your combo and other disruptive cards to control the game.

The main goal of this modern UrzaTron control deck is to assemble the Urza's Mine, Power Plant, and Tower lands to generate a large amount of mana quickly. This mana is then used to play powerful Eldrazi creatures and spells that disrupt the opponent's game plan. Karn, the Great Creator can shut down opposing artifacts, while Sowing Mycospawn and Devourer of Destiny provide alternate win conditions. The deck also includes cards like All is Dust and Ugin's Labyrinth to control the board and maintain dominance until victory is achieved.

The Boros Aggro deck focuses on maximizing damage output through a combination of efficient creatures, burn spells, and powerful enchantments. The deck aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent with a mix of aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury, while disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Static Prison and Blood Moon. With support cards like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Elegant Parlor, the deck looks to close out games swiftly and decisively while maintaining a strong board presence.

The deck focuses on quickly playing aggressive creatures and using combat tricks to overwhelm the opponent. It also utilizes cards like Goblin Bombardment and Lightning Bolt for direct damage. The key concept of the deck is to maintain a fast and aggressive tempo, while also having some control elements like Static Prison and Blood Moon to disrupt the opponent's strategy. Jegantha, the Wellspring is included as a companion to provide additional value and flexibility. Overall, the Boros Aggro deck aims to win the game quickly through a combination of creature damage and direct burn spells.

This deck focuses on a fast and aggressive playstyle with a combination of creatures, spells, and enchantments. It aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy with cards like Thoughtseize and Galvanic Discharge while quickly building a board presence with creatures like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Amped Raptor. The inclusion of the companion Jegantha, the Wellspring adds an extra layer of versatility. The deck also includes cards like Goblin Bombardment and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury for direct damage and control options. Overall, the deck seeks to overwhelm the opponent with relentless aggression and disruption.

The deck focuses on generating mana quickly with cards like Pyretic Ritual and Ruby Medallion, allowing the player to cast spells like Glimpse the Impossible and Ral, Monsoon Mage multiple times in a single turn. The deck also includes ways to draw cards and find key pieces with cards like Wish and Valakut Awakening. By efficiently casting spells and generating mana, the deck aims to assemble a winning combination of cards to overwhelm the opponent in a single explosive turn.

This Ruby Storm deck aims to quickly generate mana using rituals and Manamorphose to cast Ral, Monsoon Mage and other spells to deal high amounts of damage to the opponent. The deck utilizes cards like Glimpse the Impossible to draw cards and Past in Flames to recast spells from the graveyard. The goal is to string together a series of spells and rituals to create a lethal storm count and burn the opponent out in a single turn. The deck is focused on fast-paced combo gameplay and efficient mana generation.

This Mardu Aggro deck focuses on utilizing aggressive creatures like Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury and Amped Raptor to quickly overwhelm opponents. With support from cards like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Goblin Bombardment, the deck aims to deal damage swiftly and efficiently. Additionally, the inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion provides a powerful late-game option. By combining creature aggression with strategic removal spells like Fatal Push and Thoughtseize, this deck aims to outpace opponents and secure victory through relentless pressure.

This Mono Black Control deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's strategy with a combination of hand disruption spells like Inquisition of Kozilek and Thoughtseize, while also dealing with threats on the board through cards like Fatal Push and Fell the Profane. The deck utilizes powerful creatures like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Boggart Trawler to control the battlefield and ultimately take control of the game. With Necrodominance and Soul Spike as finishers, the deck aims to grind out opponents with its strong control elements and overwhelming threats.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on quick, aggressive gameplay by utilizing creatures like Amped Raptor and Ocelot Pride to deal damage quickly. The deck also includes powerful cards like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury to control the board and close out games. The inclusion of cards like Lightning Bolt and Static Prison help to control the opponent's creatures and disrupt their strategies. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a combination of aggressive creatures and strong removal spells.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on aggressive creatures, burn spells, and disruption to quickly deal damage to the opponent and control the game. It aims to overwhelm the opponent with a mix of fast creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Guide of Souls, along with efficient removal like Lightning Bolt. The addition of Aether Hub and Blood Moon helps to ensure consistent mana production, while cards like Arena of Glory and Static Prison provide additional control elements. The deck also includes powerful finishers like Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury and Goblin Bombardment to close out games quickly.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures and burn spells. The key strategy is to apply constant pressure with efficient creatures like Guide of Souls and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, while utilizing burn spells like Lightning Bolt to clear the way or finish off the opponent. The inclusion of cards like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury further enhances the deck's aggressive potential, aiming to win the game as quickly as possible before the opponent can stabilize.

The deck revolves around controlling the game through a combination of counterspells, removal, and powerful creatures like Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury and Teferi, Time Raveler. The key strategy is to protect The One Ring, a powerful artifact that can give you a significant advantage in the late game. The deck also includes versatile cards like Isochron Scepter and Snapcaster Mage to provide flexibility and consistency in your game plan. By managing the board and disrupting your opponent's strategy, you aim to establish dominance and win the game through attrition and superior card advantage.

The main strategy of this deck is to quickly fill up the graveyard with creatures using cards like Street Wraith and Generous Ent, and then cast Living End to bring all those creatures back onto the battlefield, potentially overwhelming the opponent. The deck also includes cards like Endurance and Force of Negation to disrupt the opponent's strategy, while Shardless Agent and Subtlety provide card advantage and flexibility. Overall, the deck aims to control the game early on and then execute its combo to finish off the opponent in a single turn.
